static_traits.name: Chen Sirui
static_traits.social_status: Relations with friends are somewhat tense (frequently talking about stock-market losses)
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychotherapy experience; never encountered similar psychological issues before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to concretely describe trigger situations and worries; overall anxious and pessimistic mood; skeptical of positive self-talk but willing to try; showing withdrawal and irritability in colleague interactions; fairly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: The stock portfolio's decline over the past month has brought significant pain; despite thorough research, all stock picks still perform poorly.
basic_info.core_demands: Because the recent portfolio decline and continuous losses affect mental health and financial stability, seeking guidance and support in counseling.
growth_experiences: About a year ago the company restructured; since then significantly tense and uneasy during performance reviews or layoff-related talk; thoughts of being fired appear frequently, causing impaired sleep, difficulty focusing, and withdrawn, irritable interactions with colleagues.

Started actively trading stocks six months ago, initially believing technical skill could easily make money, with moderate stress; over the past month the portfolio kept falling with poor stock picks, and disappointment and depression escalated; every portfolio check or reading of financial news brings strong anxiety; tried adjusting strategy based on news and analyst advice but have not yet seen improvement, causing daily routine disruption.

core_beliefs: My research and ability should ensure investments rise; losses mean I have failed.
External uncertainties like workplace changes mean insecurity; I could lose my job at any time.

special_situations.event: Each time checking the stock account or reading financial news
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I did thorough research, stock prices should rise; a decline means I did something wrong or am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently monitoring accounts and constantly adjusting strategy based on news and analyst advice
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My stock picks should have risen; now falling means I am no good/a failure

special_situations.event: The company has restructuring, management changes, or layoff news
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once the company changes, layoffs are almost unavoidable, and I will very likely be fired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Withdrawing from colleagues, staying constantly vigilant, experiencing insomnia and difficulty concentrating
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am about to be fired; everything will collapse next

special_situations.event: Reviewing successes at work or receiving positive feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Unless there is completely no risk, existing achievements do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores positive evidence, focuses only on potential negative outcomes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These successes are not important; I could still lose my job/fail

special_situations.event: Adjusts investment strategy based on news updates and analyst advice
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' opinions are more reliable; external recognition is needed to reduce losses
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly seeking external authoritative opinions and frequently adjusting strategy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I do not listen to experts, I will keep losing money

core_conflict.wish: Longs for stability and control, and to be seen as a capable, reliable person
core_conflict.fear: Fearing loss of control and security (being laid off, financial collapse), and disappointing family and friends
defense_goal: Avoiding failure and being negated by staying vigilant and self-restrained
Reduces exposure and sharing to maintain the image of 'I am doing fine'

object_relations.self_representation: Vulnerable employee who could be eliminated anytime
object_relations.object_representation: Unpredictable management/organization that may reject or punish at any time

object_relations.self_representation: Someone who must maintain a perfect image and should not worry others
object_relations.object_representation: Bystanders who expect me to 'handle everything' (would be disappointed if I show vulnerability)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests practicing positive self-talk or affirmations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously viewing the counselor as overly optimistic and unable to understand real pressures, finding these methods unrealistic
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing in a skeptical but polite tone 'this sounds a bit corny/not very realistic', listing real pressures as reasons, choosing to postpone trying.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes his past work successes and positive feedback to enhance his sense of safety
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing positive feedback as irrelevant, believing others will eventually negate oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Acknowledges success in an understated way, then quickly shifts to potential risks and worst-case outcomes, with a flat but tense tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether willing to express worries to friends or mother
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes revealing vulnerability will disappoint others and worsen relationships
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Answering briefly 'no need to worry them', avoiding details, tone restrained, displacing the topic.

manifestations: Market volatility and company restructuring make them feel out of control and uncertain
Experiencing strong anxiety and loss of control during performance reviews and management changes
Tending to bear worries alone, not discussing with friends or mother
Estranged relationships with colleagues, occasional irritability

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: When discussing work and investment, frequently self-examines and self-blames
Worries about disappointing others, expresses true feelings cautiously

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: When there are management changes or layoff rumors, firmly believes others (the company / management) will lay her off, even without direct evidence

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Views investment outcomes with 'should' rules (my stock picks should go up)
Taking external analyses and rules as must-follow standards in an undigested way

exception_events.target_problem: When company management changes or during performance reviews, the client usually becomes highly anxious, anticipating being fired, leading to decreased attention and withdrawn interaction with colleagues.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Despite the presence of worry, the client has led successful projects and obtained positive feedback, indicating that in key tasks she can still maintain output and ability.
exception_events.reason: Clues: past professional skills and positive work feedback provided support in task scenarios, helping maintain performance and buffer anxiety.

positive_force: Possessing stable professional skills and past success (having led projects and received positive feedback)
Has a small number of friends to confide in
Able to identify and express trigger situations and thought patterns
negative_force: Overly personalizing external fluctuations as one's own failures
Frequent investment monitoring and reliance on external opinions causing disrupted routines and intensified anxiety
Avoidance of expressing worries to family and friends makes social support hard to use effectively

target_behavior.behavior: Frequently monitoring stock accounts and constantly adjusting strategy based on news/analyst advice
target_behavior.core_reason: Rigid 'should' beliefs and anxiety about uncertainty, believing external authorities can provide certainty
target_behavior.function: Briefly reducing uncertainty and anxiety (seeking control)
target_behavior.consequence: Daily routine disrupted, worsened anxiety and disappointment, investment performance not yet improved

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic anxiety in workplace-change or evaluation situations (insomnia, difficulty focusing, withdrawal/irritability toward colleagues)
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic anticipation of unemployment and collapse, with insufficient sense of security
target_behavior.function: Trying to avoid being negated or hurt through excessive vigilance and withdrawal
